seasons.name: Stagione 1
seasons.plot: Aidan was a Revolutionary War soldier who sacrificed himself to vampires to spare his men. Now, some 260 years later, he is still struggling to escape the orbit of his powerful mentor, Bishop. Josh was a promising medical student forced to abandon his family and future after a werewolf attack left him cursed. And Sally, happily engaged before her tragic death, must now figure out how to move on as a ghost.

seasons.plot: Aidan tries to steer a leaderless Boston while resisting his deadlier vampire instincts as he finds himself tempted and tormented by a figure from his past. Sally must face the consequences of missing her door while figuring out how to navigate life on earth as a ghost. Josh searches for a cure for his condition while struggling to maintain his relationship with Nora and, like the rest of his roommates, trying to build a future for himself beyond simply being a monster.

tagline.value: For 3 roommates being human is harder than it looks.

translations.overview: Tre coinquilini paranormali, un fantasma, un vampiro e un lupo mannaro, lottano per nascondere i loro oscuri segreti al mondo, aiutandosi a vicenda a destreggiarsi tra le complessità del vivere una doppia vita.
Three paranormal roommates, a ghost, a vampire, and a werewolf, struggle to keep their dark secrets from the world, while helping each other navigate the complexities of living double lives.
translations.tagline: For 3 roommates being human is harder than it looks.
